name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sheet: a case docked to an edge, 3px line on the open side with an offset frame thrown onto the page, sliding in over three frames. Title in lettering; the veil comes from base.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/sheet". It wraps your own components/ui/sheet, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A case sliding in from the edge.
meta.usage:
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/sheet"

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger>Contents</SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right"><SheetTitle>Chapters</SheetTitle></SheetContent>
</Sheet>

props.name: data-side
props.description: Set on SheetContent by side. The 3px line and the offset frame follow that edge.
